//: Preset for a NestJS application under apps/*. NestJS relies on reflection-based DI, so it requires experimentalDecorators + emitDecoratorMetadata and the pre-ES2022 class-field semantics (useDefineForClassFields: false). verbatimModuleSyntax is disabled because Nest's DI reads runtime type metadata the verbatim rule would strip. Path-bearing options (rootDir, outDir, tsBuildInfoFile) and file globs live in the consuming app's tsconfig — see the note in library.json.
